correctness.rationale: For every integer base, divisibility by powers gives ν_b(b^r t)=r+ν_b(t), so the ordered occurrences of r are the scaled ordered zero-residue set S. Its omissions are isolated multiples of b. Between adjacent multiples of b^r, for a nonzero offset i<b^r, dividing by b^ν_b(i) leaves a nonmultiple of b even after adding the larger multiple. Thus the common interval interior is exactly B_r for composite as well as prime b. A short gap has return rB_r; a long gap has an omitted residue s giving central symbol (r+s) mod q and the two copies of B_r. A site b^s is a witness for each long label s≥1, and b^q and its adjacent integers in S witness short gaps, including b=2. The labels are invariant under scaling. The first b−1 sites in each consecutive base block are in S; the last site has residue 1+u_j mod q. Hence each block contributes b−2 internal short gaps and either one long gap or two short gaps including its outgoing boundary, giving termwise h(u), from the first return onward. Exact valuation strata have densities (b−1)b^(−h−1); contributions beyond level H lie among multiples of b^H, justifying the sum over residue classes. The starting-position density of r is d_r=b^(−r)d_0. The bijection between omitted sites of residue s and long returns of type s gives limiting frequencies d_s/d_0=b^(−s) in the ordered returns (endpoint discrepancies are bounded); the rest is the positive short frequency. The average length is b^r times one plus the long mass, giving 1/d_r. An independently written divisibility-sieve check tested 12 pairs b∈{2,3,4,6}, q=2,3,4: for all 36 letter systems it observed every predicted type, no other type, and agreement with the coded prefix; exact rational reciprocal-density arithmetic was also checked. Replay: python3 -B /workspace/repro/4.py; /workspace/repro/4.log. This corroborates the proof but does not establish the infinite limits.

evidence: The binary Θ_1 theorem, its identification of first and second return types, and letter frequencies give the classical case: the return words for a are ab and a, for b are baaa and ba (first seen in that order), and the long fraction is (2/3)/(2/3+2·1/3)=1/2.
For q=2 and b≥3 the prior ordered zero-site gap sequence has exactly the same normalized short/long ratios; the new distinctions involve the intervening residues for q>2.
Given the phase model for b=2, adjoining the terminal r to a candidate return word makes the occurrence a completed-return event, allowing computation of each such marginal from the phase weights.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Do not credit the classical binary result, the known binary gap law or the base-two frequency method as new. The joint claim of an explicit full return alphabet with q−1 long labels, common ordered transduction, and explicit type law at arbitrary base and modulus is not an evaluated specialization of those results.

evidence: Goč–Mousavi–Shallit identify ν_b(t) mod 2 with the fixed point of 0↦0^(b−1)1, 1↦0^b for arbitrary b.

Huang–Wen use a=0, b=1 in the classical period-doubling word. Both single letters have type-1 envelopes: E_(1,1)=a and E_(1,2)=aba contains b, while E_(2,1)=aa does not. Their Θ_1 coding is a↦a, b↦bb; relabel its outputs a as long (1) and b as short (0) to get exactly h(0)=1, h(1)=00. Theorem 4.1 gives that coding for the two letters.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: These substitutions, valuations, and binary return codes are genuinely equivalent where the parameters agree. The single-letter binary base-two coding in particular is covered, not just related; neither source has a general cyclic alphabet and arbitrary base together.

originality.rationale: There is exact classical binary overlap and covered arbitrary-base binary gap behavior; neither is the distinct all-b, all-q contribution. The supported contribution is the uniform single-letter full return-word formula, common termwise coded sequence and limiting type law for the general cyclic alphabet and integer base. A same-day all-length binary-base frequency result supplies phase data for return frequencies in that base but not an explicit ordered return system for general b. Priority beyond the inspected sources is unresolved.

value.rationale: A return-word system is a canonical induced symbolic system, and a full q-letter return classification with a common coded order across all distinguished letters is stronger than a length or frequency count. The long-label refinements, the explicit code and its measure data give a portable exact invariant for this natural substitution family. The contribution is a concise arithmetic classification, not a new general return-word theory or a claim about arbitrary factors.
